title: Artifact as hero
summary: The hero shows the product's literal interaction (the prompt box you type into, the one-line diff you'd make, the code and what it compiles into), not a screenshot or an abstraction.
use_when: When adopting the product is literally one action.
avoid_when: Complex products whose first step isn't representative.
specimen_html:
Change one line. That's the whole migration.

The hero is the thing you'd actually do, not a picture of the product.
